note: Ottawa County OK (40115) publishes no queryable parcel service or file that we could find. The county assessor says it maintains a parcel mapping system but links only to a land-records search site (okcountyrecords.com) and okassessor.com, with no GIS endpoint. The OK Geographic Information Office statewide parcel dataset is view-only (WMS) with no download and no WFS parcel layer in GeoServer capabilities. The only Oklahoma parcel REST service found (OWRB Hazard/Parcels MapServer, listed as 'Oklahoma parcels by county') was unreachable from our environment; the OWRB CSA server version requires a token. Remaining Ottawa County parcel sources are commercial (Regrid, ACRES, DataCrossPoint), not county-published.
